privacy.heroSub: Kisan Mitra is built for Indian farmers. We are committed to protecting your personal data and being transparent about how we use it.
privacy.footerDate: This policy is effective as of
privacy.s1txt1: When you register, we collect your name, mobile number, village/address, and preferred language. This information is used solely to create and manage your account.
privacy.s1txt2: We collect data you voluntarily enter including machine usage records, profit calculations, crop information, land size, and farming type. This data belongs to you.
privacy.s1txt3: With your permission, we access your device location to show nearby mandi prices and local weather forecasts. Location is never stored on our servers.
privacy.s1txt4: We may collect device type, operating system version, and app version for debugging and improving app performance.
privacy.s2txt1: Your data is used to provide app features: showing mandi prices near you, weather alerts for your location, managing your machines and profit records, and sending reminders.
privacy.s2txt2: With your consent, we send push notifications for weather alerts, mandi price changes, and reminders you set. You can disable these anytime in Settings.
privacy.s2txt3: Anonymized, aggregated usage data helps us understand which features are most useful and improve the app experience for all farmers.
privacy.s2txt4: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. We do not use your data for advertising. We do not share your farm data with any government or commercial entity without your explicit consent.
privacy.s3txt1: All data transmitted between your device and our servers is encrypted using HTTPS/TLS. Your account is protected by OTP-based authentication — no passwords to remember or leak.
privacy.s3txt2: Your data is stored on secure servers in India. We follow industry-standard security practices including regular security audits and access controls.
privacy.s3txt3: When you delete your account, all your personal data, machine records, profit history, and reminders are permanently and irreversibly deleted from our servers within 30 days.
privacy.s4txt1: We use OpenWeatherMap API to provide weather forecasts. Your location coordinates may be shared with OpenWeatherMap solely to fetch weather data.
privacy.s4txt2: Mandi price data is sourced from data.gov.in (Government of India open data portal). No personal data is shared with this service.
privacy.s4txt3: We use Twilio to send OTP messages for account verification and deletion. Your mobile number is shared with Twilio only for this purpose.
privacy.s4txt4: We use OpenStreetMap (Leaflet) for mandi location maps. This is an open-source service and no personal data is shared.
privacy.s5txt1: You can view and edit your profile information anytime from the Profile → Edit Profile screen.
privacy.s5txt2: You can request a copy of all your data by contacting us at privacy@kisanmitra.app. We will provide it within 30 days.
privacy.s5txt3: You can permanently delete your account and all associated data from Settings → Delete Account. This requires OTP verification for security.
privacy.s5txt4: You can enable or disable specific notification types (weather, mandi, reminders) from Settings → Notifications at any time.
privacy.s6txt1: Kisan Mitra is intended for farmers and agricultural workers aged 18 and above. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18.
privacy.s7txt1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes through the app or via SMS. Continued use of the app after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
